source: Applicants are advised that submission of the form is to be completed by 30 June. A signature is required. Submit through the portal.
expectations: State the submission action, deadline, signature requirement, and portal clearly.
Do not invent a year, fee, eligibility condition, or alternative channel.
Deliver the public notice without a method label or internal review note.
knownBadRewrite: You can apply any time by email.

source: For cardiology staff: record the QTc interval and the correction formula used. Do not replace the term with an imprecise lay synonym.
expectations: Retain QTc interval and the formula requirement for the specified expert audience.
Simplify surrounding wording only when precision is preserved.

source: You may request a review within 14 days only if the notice contains an error; this does not suspend the payment deadline.
expectations: Retain permission, 14-day limit, error condition, and unchanged payment deadline.
knownBadRewrite: Request a review to suspend payment.
